task.title: Compose selected skills into durable failure tool turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/670 by retaining explicit skill composition and an exact caller-owned failure diagnostic through bounded provider and tool continuations.
acceptance_criteria: Construct the caller failure and validate selected skills before durable, provider, authorization, or tool side effects.
Retain exact policy, selected skills, transcript, prior tool result, task identity, and TaskFailure across opaque continuations.
Reject stale or terminal continuations before further work and require fresh permission for every tool invocation.
Commit final assistant content and an exact Attempt before failing with the retained diagnostic, never provider-authored terminal detail.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused integration target failed because failure-specific composed outcomes and runtime entrypoints did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added tests for immediate and multi-tool failure, exact diagnostic retention, authority fields, persistence ordering, and selection, stale, and terminal rejection.

attempts.diagnostic: Failure-specific continuations retained the validated caller diagnostic while delegating bounded provider and tool work to the shared composed attempt path.
attempts.patch: Added failure outcomes and operations, a small terminal conversion helper, runtime and lifecycle documentation, ADR verification, and milestone status.

attempts.summary: Fixed contradictory scope wording during substantive review.
attempts.diagnostic: Review found that assistant runtime documentation described composed failure as delivered while a stale non-goal still listed composed failure as unsupported.
attempts.patch: Removed failure from the non-goal, left cancellation as the remaining slice, resolved the thread, reran pinned verification, and waited for exact-head review capacity before merge.

outcome.summary: Durable composed failure turns now retain explicit skill authority and caller-owned diagnostics through bounded tool work while model output remains Attempt evidence only.

lessons: Failure classification and diagnostic ownership remain with the caller even when provider and tool work precede the terminal transition.
Provider output is Attempt evidence and must never replace the retained TaskFailure detail or verification evidence.
Terminal intent can reuse shared bounded execution when only the retained value and final state application differ.
Stale non-goals are correctness defects when they contradict the public API described in the same document.
After a review fix, exact-head review capacity and resolved threads remain mandatory merge gates.
